scope: Allocated-CPU checkpoint writer preserving raw, stored and decompressed hashes.

contract.lift_success: Every observed phase in [0.52,0.60) has egg height >= initial height + 0.05 m and nonzero (>1e-12 N) contacts with both finger links, counted at crossing 0.60.
contract.descent: Height decreases by more than 0.001 m over one dt=0.01 step in the named controller window.
contract.tail: Per-environment recorded fit evaluations, sample counts, integration retries and elastic work. These are parallel work proxies, not individual GPU wall times.
contract.timing: Both device collection kernels and the public position getter are inside each rollout step. Boundary exports are outside repeat timing.

limitations: Current low-shell FP64/Q10/s8 source, two complete 1280-step trajectories after600 warmup. First pass fences once per step; second fences each measured native stage, so both are diagnostic latencies and not headline throughput. Work collection/export and field captures are outside step latency. Actual hard/retry environments remain included. Independent CPU assembles the same mesh stiffness, uses its own gauge/factor, checks all residual rows against unchanged budget and compares full tensor/von Mises fields and GPU global peak. The oracle receives captured balanced RHS; this check does not independently reconstruct dynamic contact fitting or centrifugal/inertia relief, which remain covered by separate contact/force-frame fixtures. No per-environment GPU wall-time attribution, physical convergence or RL training claim. Broad batch/seed rates, remaining measured optimization decisions and plateau remain active work.
